name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's passion for motorsport began in his childhood, watching rally races with his father. He honed his skills in automotive painting and customization, working on everything from vintage cars to high-performance vehicles. Drawn by the precision and artistry required, he transitioned to motorsport, seeking to apply his expertise in creating visually striking and aerodynamically optimized paint schemes. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to translate a team's vision into a stunning visual identity on the track.

At Sprint Masters, Krzysztof approaches each project with a blend of technical expertise and creative flair. He believes that a well-executed paint job is not merely cosmetic but can also contribute to the car's overall performance by minimizing drag and maximizing visibility. He is constantly experimenting with new materials and techniques to push the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport livery. He's also known for his collaborative spirit, working closely with engineers and designers to ensure that the final product meets both aesthetic and performance requirements.

physical.description: Krzysztof is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always listens to classic rock while working.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his workbench.
Meticulously cleans his spray guns after every use, almost obsessively.
